page.title: Governance
page.purpose: Show fixed-port compliance findings with the contract and concrete remediation needed for each violation.

priorities.statement: Make non-compliance actionable without hiding compliant routes.
Keep partial audit results visible and attributed.

states.description: Findings, filters, and remediation guidance are visible.
All observed exposed routes comply with the fixed-port contract.
Some scenarios could not be audited while available findings remain visible.
Last findings remain visible during refresh.
Audit failed and identifies the failed source.

regions.purpose: Render governance findings through loading, ready, empty, partial, stale, and failed states.

claims.statement: The Governance page exposes a stable named main region.
Every non-empty governance finding includes the expected fixed-port contract and a concrete remediation path.
